Register a network's weight-block layout for solving

Source: R/nnEval.R
nnSetMeta.Rd

The single-hidden-layer MLP `nn<K>(id, ...)` reads its weights from a contiguous block of the solve parameter vector. This records, for network `id`, where that block starts (`base`, zero-based index into `rxode2::rxModelVars(model)$params`) and the network dimensions.

Usage

nnSetMeta(id, base, K, H, act = "relu")

Arguments

id

integer network id (0-based, matches the first `nn<K>()` argument).

base

zero-based index of the first weight (`W1[0]`) in the model's parameter order.

K

input dimension.

H

hidden width.

act

activation: one of "relu", "softplus", "tanh".

Value

invisibly TRUE.
